title: Responsibility of Parents in the Tarbiyah of Children

text_simplified: Parents are responsible for the tarbiyah (upbringing and education) of their children, and Allah will question them about it on the Day of Judgment. It is incumbent upon parents to teach their children good akhlaq (character) and to care for them. The tarbiyah of children is both a right and a duty upon parents.
